scope: Proposition 4.6 of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (T0, Φ0) be an ordinary klt pair on a normal globally Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfold, with KT0 a Q-line bundle and effective real boundary. Suppose a(E; T0, Φ0) > 1 for every exceptional prime divisor E over T0. Every sequence of ordinary (KTi + Φi)-flips starting at this pair terminates, provided all models are normal globally Q-factorial compact Kähler fourfolds, each KTi is a Q-line bundle, and each flip is given by projective small contractions Ti fi − − → Zi f+ i ← − − − Ti+1 with −(KTi + Φi) relatively ample for fi and KTi+1 + Φi+1 relatively ample for f+ i . Here Φi+1 is the strict transform of Φi. No pseudo-effectivity or bigness assumption is required.
